analysis: The trial completed successfully with macro validation HR@10 of 0.4313, improving over the parent’s 0.4263 by 0.0050 but missing the targeted 0.01 improvement. Category HR@10: Movies_and_TV 0.405, Industrial_and_Scientific 0.515, Electronics 0.325, CDs_and_Vinyl 0.480. It remains below the reported SASRec baseline of 0.505. The result supports a modest aggregate benefit from this change; without parent category scores or repeated seeds, category-specific gains and robustness are unproven.
code_summary: AttentiveSimilarity retains 96-dimensional context/target embeddings, candidate-conditioned attention, square-root attention normalization, and candidate bias. Eight zero-initialized learned recency buckets add bounded signed attention-logit biases using reverse nonpadding interaction ranks. Prefix sampling, history augmentation, 16 negatives, cross-entropy, embedding regularization, AdamW, and checkpoint selection remain unchanged. The predictor imports the revised class and strictly restores recency_bias for all four dataset routes. Included checks cover zero-bias parent equivalence, bucket boundaries, padding exclusion, finite empty-history scores, and checkpoint round trips.
